sloka: मणिरत्नं कपिवरः प्रतिगृह्याभिवद्य च ।सीतां प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा प्रणतः पार्श्वतः स्थितः ।। ५.३८.७१।।।।
transliteration: maṇiratnaṁ kapivaraḥ pratigṛhyābhivadya ca ।sītāṁ pradakṣiṇaṁ kṛtvā praṇataḥ pārśvataḥ sthitaḥ ।। 5.38.71।।।।

translations.english: Having recieved the jewel from Sita and circumambulated her, Hanuman offered salutations to her and stood by her.
